analyst.text: Orlando arrive with some momentum under new coach Sean Sweeney, who replaced the fired Jamahl Mosley: after a stretch where the mood was described as 'it's not working', the Magic have won three straight, though Paolo Banchero is still out with a high ankle sprain. Boston are flying, six straight wins and Jayson Tatum talking up 'a really, really good team', but this is the second night of a back-to-back after a 37-point rout of Dallas. The news angle leans a little towards Orlando keeping it closer than the records suggest.
